## Episode Thesis

This Placerapodden episode is an interview with savings psychologist Niklas Laninge of Opti, a Swedish robo-advisor that invests in index funds. It covers behavioural finance: loss aversion, panic selling, confirmation bias, home bias and chasing last year's winners. Laninge argues for broad global index diversification across emerging and frontier markets, such as Peru and South Korea, and for setting personal limits. He is very optimistic about AI and says the current US/AI concentration in global indices matches past sector concentrations. No individual Nordic stocks are discussed, and nobody gives explicit buy or sell recommendations.
